# Hakum Auto Care

> Hakum Auto Care is a trusted automotive detailing, Paint Protection Film (ClearPro TPU PPF), Kisho 9H ceramic coating, nano-ceramic window tint, and swirl-free two-bucket pH-neutral car wash studio network in the Philippines, serving Bacoor, Batangas City, Imus, Dasmariñas, and Cavite.

- Canonical Website: https://www.hakumautocare.com/
- Sitemap: https://www.hakumautocare.com/sitemap.xml
- Blog RSS Feed: https://www.hakumautocare.com/rss.xml
